notes: Operating temperature +15°C to +75°C; module may turn up from cold start at -5°C and reach spec after self-heating. Storage -40°C to +85°C. Rx_LOS assert -28.0 dBm set for 400G modes; configurable per module. OIF 400ZR typical reach header lists 80–120 km (app 0x01), 10 dB / 25 km (app 0x02), 2400 ps/nm, CFEC. Tx power is average; host may provision within stated min–max range or default to max; host attenuation up to 10 dB (OpenZR+ footnote). OpenZR+ Rx @ OSNR and penalty columns per footnote 2: min OSNR @ min Rx power for that OSNR. CDC range footnote 3: CD range with less than 0.5 dB OSNR penalty. Maximum provisionable CD: 400G CFEC DP-16QAM 2400 ps/nm; 400G oFEC DP-16QAM 52000 ps/nm; 300G oFEC DP-8QAM 100000 ps/nm; 200G oFEC DP-QPSK 100000 ps/nm; 100G oFEC DP-QPSK 160000 ps/nm. Enhanced mode1 better optical performance, not fully interoperable with OpenZR+. Absolute max Rx signal +13 dBm; Rx total input +15 dBm. Latency: 400G CFEC 8 µs; 400G oFEC 5 µs; 300G oFEC 6 µs; 200G oFEC 7 µs; 100G oFEC 11 µs.
suggestions: Distinguish CMIS application codes (1–14) from IEEE host electrical interface IDs if both appear in future sheets. Mode-specific parameters could be modeled as an array of application profiles to avoid flattening distinct mode tuples into global lists.
